meta.title: The Boy with the Gold Crown

paragraphs: On Saturday, there was a parade in the town. Tom, Ben, Lily, and Mia went to the parade together. Before the parade, Teacher Nick gave each child a paper crown. Ben's crown was gold, and Tom's crown was silver. Ben also wore a red belt over his white shirt. The street was full of music, and the children walked along it. It was a very exciting day.

Then the parade stopped for a minute. Tom turned around, but Ben was not there. "Where is Ben?" asked Lily. "Why did he go away?" asked Mia. "I don't know," said Tom. "He is not far." "We stopped a minute ago." Tom looked at the crowd and then at the girls. "Let's look for a boy with a gold crown," he said. "He has a red belt and a white shirt."

The three of them walked slowly along the street. Lily saw a boy with a silver crown, but he was not Ben. Mia saw a girl with a gold crown, but she had no belt. Then Lily pointed to a stall. "Look at the juice stall!" she said. A boy with a gold crown stood in the line. He wore a red belt over a white shirt.

"Ben!" called Tom. Ben turned around and smiled. "I wanted some juice, and I had my money," he said. "Then I could not find you." "Next time, please tell us first," said Tom. Ben bought four glasses of orange juice with his money. The four friends drank the juice, and then they walked on with the parade.
text.summary: At a town parade, Tom loses his friend Ben. Tom describes Ben's gold crown and red belt, and Lily and Mia find him at the juice stall.
